message.content:
**Example (curl)**  

```bash
curl -s \
     --request GET \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records/cname \
     --header "x-apikey: secret123"
```

**What you’ll receive**

VT returns a JSON payload similar to:

```json
{
  "_meta": { ... },
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "CNAME_1",
      ...
    },
    {
      "id": "CNAME_2",
      ...
    }
  ]
}
```

Extract just the `id` values (`CNAME_1`, `CNAME_2`, …) – those are the **object IDs** for the CNAME records.
